services.metaDescription: Custom-made furniture, kitchens, lacquerware, Corian and wooden structures. Discover all the carpentry services of Fusteria InterFusta in Andorra.
services.title: Our *services*
services.intro: We offer a wide range of carpentry services, combining traditional craftsmanship with modern techniques for exceptional results.
services.ctaText: Each project is different. Tell us what you need and we will prepare a proposal adapted to your space and your budget.

mobles-a-mesura.title: Custom-made furniture
mobles-a-mesura.description: We design and manufacture bespoke furniture tailored to your specific needs and preferences. From elegant dining tables to bespoke cabinets, our expert craftsmen will make your vision a reality.
extra: A custom-made piece of furniture allows you to take advantage of every corner of the available space, from built-in wardrobes to furniture for areas with irregular shapes, without being limited to the standard sizes on the market.

This service is common when a space has an unconventional shape, when you want to make the most of the height or depth available, or simply when you are looking for a piece of furniture that is not in any catalogue. The starting point is never a closed model, but the real space and the use you want to give it.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We move to your space to take exact measurements and find out how you plan to use it. This way we ensure that the furniture adapts to it perfectly, both in terms of dimensions and functionality.

process.title: Design
process.text: We translate your ideas into a specific design, adjusting proportions, finishes and interior layout. We review the details with you until the result responds exactly to what you need.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: Each piece is manufactured in our workshop, where we combine artisanal techniques with modern machinery. This process allows us to control the quality of each element before it leaves for its space.

process.title: Installation
process.text: Once ready, we transport and install the furniture in its space. We check that everything fits, that the doors and drawers work correctly and that the finish is as expected.

instal-lacio-de-cuines.title: Installation of kitchens
instal-lacio-de-cuines.description: Transform your kitchen with our professional installation services. We take care of everything from cabinet assembly to custom storage solutions, ensuring perfect functionality and aesthetics.
extra: In many kitchens, the worktop is one of the elements that most defines the final finish. If you are looking for a smooth surface with no visible joints, we also work with Corian for this type of project.

The installation of a kitchen involves coordinating furniture, appliances and finishes so that they work as a whole, not as independent pieces. That is why we value the distribution of space from the first moment, before manufacturing any element.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We visit the kitchen to take precise measurements and assess the location of appliances, water and electricity. This step is key to avoid miscoordination once assembly begins.

process.title: Design
process.text: We design the distribution of cabinets, drawers and storage areas so that the kitchen is comfortable to use. We seek to ensure that each element has a place consistent with the day-to-day life of the kitchen.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We manufacture the modules and fronts in the workshop, adjusting each piece to the exact dimensions of the space. The finishes are prepared following the previously agreed design.

process.title: Installation
process.text: We assemble and install all the elements in your kitchen, checking levels and fittings. We also check the correct functioning of drawers, doors and handles before giving the job as finished.

lacatge-i-vernissat.title: Lacquering and varnishing
lacatge-i-vernissat.description: We offer professional finishing services for all types of wooden surfaces. We use specialized lacquering and varnishing techniques to protect and enhance the natural beauty of your furniture, guaranteeing a durable and elegant finish.
extra: The lacquering provides an opaque and uniform finish, while the varnishing keeps the natural grain of the wood visible. The technique is chosen according to the aesthetics you are looking for and the protection that the piece needs from daily use, humidity or light.
This service applies to both new furniture and existing pieces that need to be renewed, and is usually combined with other carpentry services when a piece also requires some prior repair.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We assess the piece or surface in your space or in our workshop to determine the condition of the wood. This is where the most appropriate type of finish for each case comes from.

process.title: Design
process.text: We define together the colour, texture and degree of gloss of the lacquer or varnish. We take into account the use that will be given to the piece and the environment in which it will be located.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We apply the lacquering or varnishing process in the workshop, in several layers. Each layer needs its drying time before applying the next, to achieve a uniform and resistant finish.

process.title: Installation
process.text: Once the finish is dry, we return it and place the piece in its place, or we deliver it ready to install. We check that the color and texture match what had been agreed.

disseny-amb-corian.title: Design with Corian
disseny-amb-corian.description: Specialists in the design and manufacture of Corian, a versatile and durable material perfect for countertops, sinks and decorative surfaces. We create unique and functional designs that adapt perfectly to your space.
extra: Corian is a solid and non-porous surface that allows you to create pieces with practically invisible joints, which makes it easier to keep it clean. Its flexibility allows it to be given curved shapes and to integrate sinks or taps into the same continuous piece, something that is not always possible with other materials.
It is a common choice for kitchen countertops, bathroom sinks and other decorative surfaces where a continuous finish is sought, without the seam lines typical of other materials.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We take exact measurements of the space where the Corian piece will be installed, taking into account taps, drains and other elements that have to fit into it.

process.title: Design
process.text: We design the shape, color and finish of the piece, assessing whether it needs invisible joints, rounded edges or integrated elements such as a sink. We define all the details before cutting the material.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We cut and shape the Corian in the workshop with the specific tools required for this material. We work to achieve continuous, well-sealed and pore-free surfaces.

process.title: Installation
process.text: We install the piece in its space, sealing the joints so that there is a uniform surface that is easy to clean, and we check that it fits correctly with taps and drains.

estructures-de-fusta.title: Wooden structures
estructures-de-fusta.description: Create stunning outdoor spaces with our wooden structures. We build pergolas, roofs and architectural elements that enhance the value of your property.
extra: As these are elements exposed to the elements, the wood used for them receives a protective treatment before assembly, to help it better resist humidity and temperature changes.

This type of structure allows you to gain an outdoor space that can be used for a large part of the year, either as a shaded area, as a roof or as an element that complements the architecture of the property.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We visit the outdoor space to evaluate the terrain, the orientation and the available sizes. These factors directly condition the type of structure that makes sense to propose.

process.title: Design
process.text: We design the pergola, roof or architectural element taking into account the use we want to give it. We seek that it integrates with the rest of the property, both in shape and finish.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We prepare the pieces of wood in the workshop, cutting them and treating them according to the defined structure. This prior preparation speeds up the subsequent assembly on the outside.

process.title: Installation
process.text: We assemble the structure in its location, fixing it securely to the ground or to the existing construction. We verify the stability and finish once the assembly is complete.

restauracio.title: Restoration
restauracio.description: Give a new life to your precious pieces of wood with our restoration services. We carefully repair and repaint furniture while preserving its original character.
extra: Restoring a piece of wood allows you to preserve its sentimental or historical value, instead of replacing it with a new one. Often this is furniture with a family value that is worth keeping in use.
The scope of restoration varies greatly depending on the condition of each piece: it can range from a simple repainting to the repair of structures or elements that no longer work properly.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We examine the piece to assess its condition, identify damage and understand how it was originally built. This diagnosis determines the real scope of the intervention.

process.title: Design
process.text: We plan the necessary intervention, deciding what needs to be repaired, reinforced or repainted. The aim is to preserve the original character of the piece at all times.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We take the piece to the workshop, where we repair the structure, replace the damaged parts if necessary and apply the corresponding finish. We work carefully to respect the original identity of the furniture.

process.title: Installation
process.text: Once restored, we return the piece or place it back in its space, checking that it is stable and ready to be used normally again.

mesuraments-i-planificacio.title: Measurements and planning
mesuraments-i-planificacio.description: Our team of experts provides accurate measurements and detailed planning services to ensure the success of your project. We take into account all the details before starting construction.
extra: Good initial planning allows you to detect possible incompatibilities before the wood reaches the workshop, which saves time and avoids having to redo work later.

This service is usually the starting point of any other carpentry project: furniture, kitchens, structures or windows, since all these jobs depend on having the correct sizes and conditions from the beginning.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: This is the core of the service: we visit the space, take all the necessary measurements and identify conditions such as electrical outlets, drains or walls that are not completely square.

process.title: Design
process.text: With the measurements collected, we draw up the detailed planning of the project: distribution, fittings and work sequence. This document is what will guide the rest of the process.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: This planning is transferred to the workshop, where it serves as a basis for each piece to be manufactured adjusted exactly to the measured space, with no margins of error that need to be corrected later.

process.title: Installation
process.text: On the day of installation, we follow the plan defined from the beginning, which speeds up assembly and reduces last-minute adjustments in the field.

finestres-i-balconeres.title: Windows and balconies
finestres-i-balconeres.description: We design and manufacture custom-made wooden windows and balcony cabinets, adapted to your needs and preferences. We use quality wood and artisanal techniques to guarantee a durable and elegant finish.
extra: As these are external elements, a protective treatment is usually applied before installation, similar to what we use in our lacquering and varnishing service.

A custom-made wooden window or balcony allows you to adjust to openings that do not follow standard sizes, which is common in older buildings or in renovations where you want to maintain consistency with the rest of the carpentry in the house.

process.title: Measurement and visit
process.text: We take the exact dimensions of the openings where the windows or balconies will go, taking into account the orientation and conditions of the existing opening.

process.title: Design
process.text: We define the type of opening, the thickness of the profile and the finish of the wood. We seek consistency with the style of the rest of the carpentry of the house.

process.title: Manufacturing in the workshop
process.text: We manufacture each window or balcony window in the workshop, precisely adjusting it to the measurements taken and applying the chosen finish before transferring it to the construction site.

process.title: Installation
process.text: We install the windows and balconies in their location, checking that they close correctly and are well sealed against air and humidity.

privacy.metaDescription: How Fusteria InterFusta collects, uses and protects the personal data you provide us through this website.
privacy.title: *Privacy Policy*
privacy.intro: How we collect, use and protect the personal data you provide to us through this website.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
paragraphs: The data controller of the data collected through this website is {company} (NRT: L-715485-U), with registered office at Passatge d'Enclar S/N, Santa Coloma, AD500, Andorra.
For any question related to the privacy of your data, you can contact us at {email} or by phone {phone}.

sections.title: 2. What data we collect
paragraphs: Through the contact form on this website we ask you for your name, surname(s), email address, telephone number and the message you wish to send us. Providing this data is voluntary, but necessary so that we can respond to your query.

sections.title: 3. For what purpose we use them
paragraphs: We use the data you provide us only to respond to your query or request for a quote, and to communicate with you about your project. We do not use this data for other commercial purposes or transfer it to third parties for advertising purposes.

sections.title: 4. Legal basis
paragraphs: The legal basis for the processing of your data is the consent you give us when you voluntarily fill in and send the contact form.

sections.title: 5. Who we share data with
paragraphs: When you send the contact form, the data is transmitted via the external service {resend}, which is responsible for sending us an email with the content of your message to {inbox}. Your data is not stored in any database of this website: it lives only in this email and in the technical records of the sending provider.
This website also uses Vercel Analytics and Vercel Speed Insights to understand, in an aggregated and non-identifying way, how the website is used and how we can improve its performance.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep the data
paragraphs: We keep the data you provide us through the form only for the time necessary to respond to your query and, where appropriate, manage the project that derives from it. If no project is formalised, we will delete the email within a maximum period of 2 years from the last communication. If an order is formalised, we will keep the data for the time required by legal obligations (for example, tax and accounting).

sections.title: 7. Your rights
paragraphs: You have the right to access your personal data, rectify it if it is inaccurate, request its deletion, and oppose or request the limitation of its processing. You can exercise these rights by sending us an email to {email}. If you believe that we have not processed your data correctly, you also have the right to file a complaint with the Andorran Data Protection Agency (APDA).

sections.title: 8. Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We may update this privacy policy to reflect changes in how we treat your data. We recommend that you review it periodically. Last updated: September 23, 2026.
